description: This file provides polyfill functions for PHP's ctype functions, defining them if they are not already available in the environment. It ensures compatibility for ctype functions by wrapping calls to the Symfony Polyfill Ctype class.

classes.name: Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype
classes.description: A class providing polyfill implementations for PHP's ctype functions, used to ensure compatibility in environments where these functions are missing.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are alphanumeric. Calls the Symfony Polyfill Ctype class method.

methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are alphabetic. Calls the Symfony Polyfill Ctype class method.
